value.rationale: Inverse-velocity failure-time plotting is a standard geophysical precursor method; a composite sensor can mathematically create a systematic late intercept and a spurious, unbounded effective acceleration exponent with unchanged constituent laws. The signed robust-to-number-of-modes bias and exact two-mode peak/bias formulas provide a motivated, falsifiable diagnostic benchmark distinguishing modal mixing from changing single-process dynamics. No field calibration or safe predictive guarantee is implied.
